## Tuning (synthetic handwriting, 10 x 20 px strokes)

Two words of 4 strokes (15 px apart inside a word); the gap between the words varies. `1` = one chunk, `2` = two chunks.

| k | gap 20 | gap 30 | gap 40 | gap 60 | gap 90 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1.0 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| 1.5 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| 2.0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 | 2 |
| 3.0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 2 |

Rows of text 40 px below each other (a normal line pitch) must stay separate chunks: one chunk would hide the structure of the page.

| k | line pitch 40 | line pitch 60 |
|---|---|---|
| 1.0 | 2 | 2 |
| 1.5 | 1 | 2 |
| 2.0 | 1 | 2 |
| 3.0 | 1 | 1 |

Id retention when a chunk of n strokes gains g strokes between two saves (J = n / (n + g) must be above the threshold; containment keeps the id whenever the old set is inside the new one):

| n \ g | 1 | 2 | 3 | 5 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | NEW ID | NEW ID | NEW ID | NEW ID |
| 2 | keeps | NEW ID | NEW ID | NEW ID |
| 3 | keeps | keeps | NEW ID | NEW ID |
| 5 | keeps | keeps | keeps | NEW ID |
| 8 | keeps | keeps | keeps | keeps |
